messages:
ashok: quick FYI — we plan to deploy the 'keystore egress splitter' in eu-west1 tomorrow 08:00 UTC. It will split audit & onboarding egress to a new proxy pool. This changes source IPs for audit-shipper. Expect short replays. Any blockers?

maria: +1 on the plan, but can we commit to a temporary audit-shipper allowlist? last time onboarding stalled ~45m because of firewall denies :grimacing:

lee: which keystore service account/role needs the KMS Decrypt grant? need to make sure the role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-proxy retains kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood/keystore

ashok: keystore-proxy role stays the same. we're only changing egress NAT to the new pool. KMS grants unaffected. canary steps: 10% traffic for 30m -> 50% 30m -> 100%. rollback on errors.

sam: cost flag: new NAT pool might route audit traffic out of private link, could add ~€900/month in eu-west1. If audit-shipper uses SQS -> s3 path via PL, cost lower. also need to check data-plane egress S3 bucket policies.

opss-bot: [maintenance-scheduler] Deploy queued: keystore-egress-splitter — 2026-03-24T08:00:00Z — runbook: /runbooks/keystore-egress-splitter

maria: can we add short-lived firewall rule with the new IP-range (203.0.113.16/28) and tag it "temp-allow-keystore" and auto-remove after 2h?

lee: +1, but ensure audit logs still show original node tags. otherwise SIEM ingestion will misclassify. Also need to update VPC flowlogs parser to map nat_ip->pool label.

ashok: plan: create temp-fw rule for audit-shipper svc, update flowlog parser, deploy canary 10% at 08:00. watchlist: node-join failures, auditshipper 5xx, onboarding latency >120s. If any triggered, rollback NAT mapping.

sam: quick snippet to verify KMS grants:
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/redwood/keystore --query "Grants[?GranteePrincipal=='arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-proxy']"
```

lee: Also add an alert on keystore-proxy decrypt errors: metric keystore.decrypt.errors > 0 for 5m should page.

maria: I can own the firewall allowlist + revert lambda. will push terraform in a PR.

ashok: thanks. tagging @oncall to be available at deploy T+0..+30. @oncall please ack.

oncall: acked. will monitor onboarding and SIEM channels.

maria: PR link -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987 (contains terraform + lambda)

ashok: cool. Ops checklist attached in runbook. :thumbsup:
